tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillations and contains both positive and negative responses near the target horizon H=1.1. Barrier activation alone does not explain these reversals. No model was confirmed at the requested RMSE tolerance of 0.045.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Each has a fixed output sign for fixed parameters, so none can explain the observed sign reversals.
Denser sampling could characterize the oscillations, but the observed high-frequency sign-oscillation signature already triggers abstention.
This probe does not address the observed nonstationarity.
